title: Billing Desk Ruling: Part-Month Billing of the Per-Worker Fee
content:
**Ruling.** For the Paystride Earned Wage Access Program Agreement, the part of the month billed for the per-worker fee follows the date the per-worker fee began to apply, every month counting as 30 days:

1. where the most recent change of the fee model to employer-paid that took effect has an effective date later than the first day of the billing month and fewer than 30 days after it, the fee is multiplied by 30 less the days from the first day of the month to that effective date, divided by 30;
2. where no such effective date falls in that span and the go-live date is later than the first day of the billing month and fewer than 30 days after it, the fee is multiplied in the same way counting from the go-live date;
3. otherwise the whole month is billed.

The change looked at is the employer's fee model change request to the employer-paid model with the latest effective date among those that took effect; the go-live date is the one on the agreement record.

## Applying the ruling (hypothetical billing months)

| Latest effective change to employer-paid | Go-live date | Days counted | Part of the month billed |
|---|---|---|---|
| the 11th of the billing month | earlier month | 10 from the change | 20 thirtieths |
| the 6th of the billing month | the 21st of the billing month | 5 from the change | 25 thirtieths |
| none in the span | the 16th of the billing month | 15 from go-live | 15 thirtieths, one half |
| the 1st of the billing month | earlier month | 0 | the whole month |
| the 31st of the billing month | earlier month | 30, not fewer than 30 | the whole month |
| a previous month | a previous month | none in the span | the whole month |

A change effective on the first day of the month is not later than that day, and a date 30 or more days after it is not fewer than 30 days after it; in both cases the month is billed whole unless the go-live date falls within the span.
